transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. What brings you to see me today?

Well... my family made me come talk to you. I keep trying to tell them that I’m the reason my friend died. I didn’t call her back when I should have, and... I had ugly thoughts sometimes. It's my fault. And now I know the Lord is punishing everybody at our church because of me. I just brought all this down on everyone.
Aside from feeling guilty, have you been feeling sad or down lately?

I don't really know if sad is the right word for it. I guess I haven't really noticed feeling like that... I just, well, I mostly just think about what I've done. I'm not sure about feeling down, exactly. I just know it's all my fault.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in doing things you normally enjoy?

Yes, I have. I used to love going to choir, and my knitting circle... I liked playing bingo, and just walking through Patterson Park. But now, I just sit in my chair. None of it really feels worth getting dressed for anymore.
Have you ever had a period of time where you felt unusually energetic, needed much less sleep than usual, or felt on top of the world?
No, I can't say I have. I've never felt like that... on top of the world or anything. I just feel tired, mostly. I definitely haven't had any extra energy.
Have you ever experienced a time in the past where you felt this way, losing interest in things and feeling so overwhelmed by guilt?

No... no, I haven't. I've never felt quite like this before. I mean, everyone has bad days, but... not like this. I've never just stopped caring about my life or felt this heavy with it all. This is the first time.
Did these thoughts about being responsible for your friend's death begin before you lost interest in your usual activities?

No, they didn't. Before she died and I sank into all this... I never thought the choir or the pastor were sending warnings about me. I didn't have any of those thoughts. They only started after I got so low and felt so guilty over these past few weeks.
